app_store.name: coree Vector Print Studio
app_store.subtitle: Offline Vector, CAD & Laser
app_store.promotional_text: Open-source pure-Rust studio for print shops, laser cutters, Arabic typography, and legacy .cdr, .pdf, .psd, and .dxf files — zero accounts or cloud lock-in.
app_store.description:
coree is an offline vector illustration, multipage layout, raster editing, and print/laser production studio built in pure Rust.

Designed for commercial print shops, sign makers, packaging converters, Arabic RTL studios, and CO2/fiber laser workshops on Linux and Windows:

- Broad Production Format Support: Open and round-trip .cdr (RIFF v4-v13, ZIP X4-X5, ZCF X6-2025), .cdr.zip, .cdt, .cmx, .cpt, .coree, PDF/AI, multi-layer PSD/PSB, EPS, AutoCAD DXF, HPGL .plt, and SVG/SVGZ with unknown-chunk passthrough and CP1256 Arabic text recovery.
- Press-Ready Output: DeviceCMYK PDF/X export with ISO 32000-1 Spot Separation plates (CutContour, Crease), axial/radial shadings, embedded custom ICC v2/v4 profiles, live CMYK soft-proofing, N-Up/Booklet/Tiling imposition, printer marks, Preflight, Collect for Output, and native CUPS / Windows Spooler printing.
- Laser & Plotter Bridge System: Built-in toolpath optimization (duplicate-line removal, open-curve joining, kerf offset, cross-hatch fill, inner-first ordering) exporting GRBL/Marlin/Ruida G-Code, DXF R12, and PLT with 7 built-in machine bridge presets.
- 65 Interactive Tools & 11 Live Lenses: Parametric shapes, Node Editor (F10), Edit Fill (F11), Outline Pen (F12), Boolean shaping, PowerClip lockable containers, Mesh Fill, Break Effect Apart (Ctrl+K), Healing/Dodge/Burn/Flood Fill, Vector Tracing, and live Path Meter.
- Bilingual Arabic & English Studio: HarfBuzz RTL shaping, Kashida justification, Unicode BiDi mixed-script menus, and OS-physical keyboard shortcuts.

google_play.title: coree Vector Print Studio
google_play.short_description: Offline vector studio for print prepress, laser cuts, Arabic RTL, and .cdr IO.
google_play.full_description:
coree is a clean-room, open-source vector illustration, multipage page-layout, raster editing, and prepress/laser production studio written in pure Rust under a dual MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.

Built to keep workshops working offline without accounts, activation servers, or forced subscriptions:

- Import & Round-Trip Legacy Archives: Open RIFF, ZIP, and ZCF .cdr/.cdr.zip, .cdt, .cmx, .cpt, PDF/AI, EPS, PSD/PSB, DXF, PLT, and SVG files while preserving unrecognized binary chunks.
- Commercial Print & Packaging: Export curved Arabic & Latin glyphs to DeviceCMYK PDF with Spot /Separation inks (CutContour), custom ICC v2/v4 OutputIntents, imposition layouts, Preflight checks, vector QR/EAN-13 barcodes, parametric FEFCO dielines, CSV Print Merge, and direct CUPS / Windows printing.
- Laser & Plotter Toolpaths: Remove duplicate lines, join open paths, apply kerf compensation and rotated hatch engraving, and export G-Code (GRBL/Marlin/Ruida), DXF R12, or HPGL .plt.
- Fast Offline Architecture: R-Tree spatial indexing, Rayon parallel dirty-tile rendering, SQLite WAL command-journal crash recovery, sandboxed Rhai automation macros, and live English / Arabic bilingual workspaces.
